# Soshka — Premium Women's & Kids' Jewellery

> Soshka (soshka.in) is a premium Indian e-commerce store specialising in anti-tarnish fashion jewellery for women and kids. We offer earrings, necklaces, bracelets, rings, bangles, hair accessories, and curated gift sets, shipped across all of India with secure payments via Razorpay.

## About Soshka

Soshka is owned and operated by Aleef Global, based in Kannur, Kerala, India. We curate handpicked, high-quality, hypoallergenic jewellery that combines contemporary design with advanced anti-tarnish technology, ensuring pieces retain their brilliance for years.

- **Founded**: Kannur, Kerala, India
- **Speciality**: Anti-tarnish fashion jewellery for women and kids
- **Shipping**: Pan-India delivery (2-5 business days)
- **Payment Methods**: Razorpay (UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets) and Cash on Delivery (COD)
- **Returns**: 48-hour return window for damaged or defective items (unboxing video required)

## Product Categories

- Earrings (studs, hoops, drops, danglers)
- Necklaces (chains, pendants, layered sets)
- Bracelets & Bangles
- Rings (stacking, statement, solitaire)
- Hair Accessories (clips, headbands, pins)
- Kids Jewellery (nickel-free, lead-free, safety clasps)
- Gifts & Curated Sets
